feature: RTF hidden character state suppresses structural table separators
referencePolicy: Writer consumes a fallback control word as formatting and continues fallback skipping across braces. RTF1.9.1 pp14-15 requires a control word count of one and termination at a group delimiter; retain reader character semantics for these 24 cases. Not reader defects.

referenceSources.basis: Unicode fallback token/group rules; cell and row control words partition table structure. Hidden character formatting cannot stand in for removal of a table boundary.

rootCause: rtf-reader WORD_TEXT cell/nestcell/row/nestrow are sent through appendText, which suppresses them under isHidden(). This concatenates visible cells around a hidden mark. nesttableprops has a separate row path, so nesting variants must be checked together.
visibleEvidence: Two actual host rendered trees in Chrome visibly show LEFTRIGHT where unmodified Writer HTML shows separate LEFT and RIGHT cells. All 72 actual host outputs match baseline parser, including the failures.

Verify actual content on host and Chrome, independent native output, failed/repeated opens and linked RTF regressions; then complete existing gates and PR.
limitations: No full table layout or merged-cell support claim.
